title: Six-Wheel Builder UGV: transparent cost framework
new_vs_used: All line assumptions new; no speculative used discounts. Used arms require inspection and could increase refurbishment/integration.

battery.facts: 51.2 V, 30 Ah, 15.6 kg; maximum 10 in parallel, no series; manufacturer lists >3500 cycles at 80% DOD, not a mission-life guarantee

camera.unit: one new ZED X without polarizer or cable
camera.facts: Polarizer +$50; 1.5 m cable +$25; GMSL2 capture hardware required

compute.facts: Out of stock when checked; reference price only, not production computer selection

compute_limits.facts: Developer kits warranted for development use only. Module price tiers do not include carrier, enclosure, storage and integration.

arm.facts: UR20 20 kg, 25 kg conditional, 1750 mm reach. Page requests pricing; allowance is analyst assumption, not vendor quote.

screwdriver.facts: SD-100 0.3–4 Nm, M2.5–M5, 65 L/min air; insufficient for structural fasteners.

compatibility.facts: FAQ lists screwdriver compatibility UR3–UR16 CB/E series, so UR20 compatibility must be confirmed.

printer.unit: new MK4S kit reference; assembled reference $999
printer.tax_shipping: Comparison table associates VAT inclusion with EUR. USD tax, duties and destination shipping unverified; do not treat as checkout total.
printer.facts: MK4S kit is a human-oriented assembly benchmark; no robotic assembly claim.

drive_catalog.facts: Candidate reduction drive specifications only. Exact 51.2 V motor/inverter and regen compatibility unverified.

tire_catalog.facts: Reference tire; load/pressure-specific qualification and price remain unverified.

contingency.basis: Planning allowance on hardware and cell totals, not a statistical confidence interval; does not replace NRE

engineering_nre.basis: Analyst scenario, not estimate backed by a work breakdown/schedule. Includes controls, mechanical/electrical integration, perception, task programming and validation. Broader unstructured autonomy can exceed this.
engineering_nre.prototype_build_labor: Separately allow 300–700 technician hours per robot at $75–125/h ($22,500–87,500); not included in hardware or NRE; tailor after assembly process trial.
engineering_nre.boundary: NRE is engineering/design/software/integration validation effort; routine technician fabrication/assembly/rework of each physical robot is in separate direct-build labor. Supplier fabrication labor already embedded in purchased frame allowance must not be charged twice.

operating_assumptions.warning: All operating/lifetime/utilization values are explicit scenario inputs, not validated performance or local tariffs. Supervision is unproven and may be 1:1 or greater.

operating_scenarios.name: workshop
operating_scenarios.display_guidance: Round to whole dollars or ~nearest $5/h; decimals are calculation traceability, not estimate precision.

operating_scenarios.name: field
operating_scenarios.display_guidance: Round to whole dollars or ~nearest $5/h; decimals are calculation traceability, not estimate precision.

formulas.mass: m = dry_mass + payload + consumables; do not add payload twice if gross_mass used
formulas.battery_power_kw: wheel_power_kw/drive_efficiency + aux_kw + arm_kw + compressor_kw + thermal_kw + terrain_scrub_kw; duty-cycle by mission segment; no regenerative credit assumed
formulas.runtime_h: available_kwh / mean_battery_power_kw; invalid when peak current/thermal or traction constraints fail
formulas.replicated_peer_cost: purchased_BOM + direct_human_assembly_labor + occupied_robot_hours*machine_rate + workcell_allocation + QA/rework/scrap + procurement/logistics; never assume robot assembly makes purchased parts free

kit_scenarios.module_kit: Assemble procured pretested wheel/steer, battery, arm/controller, electronics and structural modules. Cost reduction is assembly time hypothesis requiring a trial, not hardware discount. Requires lift, fixtures, robot-compatible interfaces and precrimped harnesses.
kit_scenarios.loose_parts: Includes individual purchased bearings, motors, reducers, fasteners and wire; more fixtures/feeders, fastening/termination tooling, QA and human interventions. No default cost saving or automatic assembly time assumed. Cells/electronics/precision reducers remain purchased.
kit_scenarios.field_module_kit: Adds transport, site preparation, setup/teardown, contamination controls and weather/ground downtime. Cannot reuse workshop productivity assumption.
kit_scenarios.field_loose_parts: Research scenario; no credible production cost or throughput estimate until demonstrated.

printer_benchmark.status: EXTERNAL PRICE BENCHMARK ONLY. MK4S 250×210×220 mm is smaller than required 300 mm-class envelope; NOT the selected baseline printer, NOT a valid cost substitute.
printer_benchmark.selected_printer: 300 mm-class printer must be separately selected and quoted; offboard print-package allowance remains unquoted $2.5k/$5k/$10k for two machines and supporting services.

uncertainty: Most dollars are unquoted planning allowances; precise public-price anchors do not make the integrated machine estimate precise. Verify final supplier BOM, compatibility, payload/reach, current/thermal limits and process acceptance tests before procurement.

battery_electrical_validation.architecture: 51.2 V nominal; modules connected in parallel only; never series
battery_electrical_validation.warning: Do not multiply module maximum current into a guaranteed system rating: current sharing, harnesses, fuses, contactors, busbars, thermal limits and worst-case module dropout need validation. Exact traction motor/inverter voltage range, regenerative-bus behavior and arm-controller power conversion remain design gates; costs do not establish compatibility.

hardware_readiness: Engineering baseline only, no purchasable complete qualified BOM. Public prices are reference observations, availability unconfirmed except NVIDIA marked out-of-stock; commercial packages require quotes.
